header: Ask for a copy of the data we hold on you
description: Portal accounts, quotation history and service tickets are filed under your company's customer number. Tell us which of those you need, whether you want an export or a deletion, and we answer within 30 days. Requests are matched against the contact list your buyer signed off.
privacy_text: Handled by the data protection officer in Graz and deleted 90 days after the case is closed.
